name: agent-step-toolkit
description: Build agent-step LangGraph projects and tools — bootstrap a new project (runner library + streaming CLI + scaffold + the required local sandbox service), define graph state once as a Zod schema (single source of truth for reducers + invoke-boundary validation, channel-completeness enforced at construction; agent-step 2.0.0), localize/override every runner-emitted summary via templated system messages, add domain tools (actions / executors / verifiers / controller hooks + invalidatesOnChange; executors request library-state transitions via typed effects) with sandbox extensions per backend, offer engine-owned one-shot bounded choices with turn-provenance locks, add channel-handoff actions with orchestrator/specialized agent roles, completed/abandon/off_topic handbacks, and library-coordinated off-topic delegation (agent-step 2.0.0; the bootstrap scaffold ships the channel middleware wire/streaming contract), port an existing project onto agent-step, offer Kafka run-tracing observability at bootstrap/port time via the companion kafka-observability plugin (/add-kafka-observability; /pull-library reports when a project's vendored observability library is behind), apply the three-layer test methodology (runner unit / sandbox / prompt-input), and audit a channel middleware implementation against the wire/streaming/handoff contract.
